protocol: Union of supplied line polygon and its supplied character polygons; preserve original RGB and predicted mask. Reject any annotated neighbour overlap >5%, out-of-image polygon, or any character with <20 foreground pixels. Fixed geometry/quality thresholds, no model-result selection.
limitations: Labels remain unverified Roman dataset strings with | separators.
Unannotated neighbours and missing characters cannot be detected by this audit.
Geometry repair cannot recover strokes absent from the predicted mask.
